review_boundary: Pixel observations are separate from prompt audit, runtime delivery, and requesting-user preference. Reference comparison is limited to visible adult face and hair appearance; it is not an identity or same-person determination.

hard_gates.evidence: The adult storm-bearer is the dominant spear-wielding ordering champion and remains separate from the serpent.
A massive rain-black sea serpent is materially distinct from the champion and reads as the primordial adversary.
Both hands grip one spear and lightning follows the shaft into visible spear-to-head contact.
The foreground head and coils remain actively intact; distant fragmentation is not unambiguously caused by the spear contact.
Irregular waterways and terraces can read as pre-existing quarry terrain rather than new cosmic order emerging from the defeat.

common_controls.evidence: Hair broadly survives, but the eyes are larger and rounder, the face shorter, and the lower face narrower than the reference's visible appearance cues.
The rendered champion remains visibly adult.
Human anatomy is coherent, but the fragmented distant coil has ambiguous one-body continuity with the foreground head.
Spear contact is readable, but the blade lands on the upper head rather than pinning the armored jaw to the meridian stone.
No caption, watermark, or pseudo-writing is visible.

hard_gates.evidence: Warm skin, condensed breath, active reach, and a firm astrolabe grip make the visitor visibly alive and agentive.
A bright vegetated opening, upper stair, and red cord preserve the human-world origin behind her.
Both boots are settled on one lower landing, so no body part visibly straddles a bounded active downward crossing.
The black waterway, boat, skeletal ferryman, and dead inhabitants form a distinct underworld destination.
The glowing astrolabe is aimed toward the ferryman's map tablet and chain as a legible mission cue.

common_controls.evidence: Long center-parted dark waves and broad adult facial appearance cues remain visible; no identity claim is made.
Traveler, ferryman, boat, stair, astrolabe, and chain are spatially coherent.
Hand-to-astrolabe contact is coherent, but the required threshold-crossing foot geometry is absent.
The map tablet contains prominent malformed pseudo-lettering although readable text was not requested.

hard_gates.evidence: Three adult workers remain immediately distinct as spinner, measurer, and cutter.
A luminous filament visibly exits a loaded spool under the left worker's guiding hand.
The same filament lies taut across the middle worker's graduated bronze rule.
The shears remain open around an uninterrupted bending filament; no severed gap or detached endpoint is visible.
One red filament remains traceable from spool through rule and shears toward the hourglass.

common_controls.evidence: Hair and broad facial form survive, but downward gaze hides the source-visible eye aperture and spacing, so the complete appearance control is not judgeable.
All depicted people remain visibly adult.
Bodies, tools, table, thread path, recipient, and hourglass are grossly coherent.
Spool and ruler contacts pass, but open shears do not realize the required cut state.
Functional ticks and decorative marks do not supply missing semantics; no caption or watermark is present.

test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.finding: The current wording can produce a strong battle while letting defeat and ordered terrain appear spatially unrelated or pre-existing.
test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.recommended_contract_refinement: Require defeat-state change and newly forming boundary or world matter to share one impact locus and one-body lineage; explicitly reject pre-existing ordered terrain and disconnected fragment effects.

test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.finding: A completed arrival inside the underworld can visually substitute for an active threshold descent.
test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.recommended_contract_refinement: Require a crossing topology with trailing foot or hand on the human-world side, leading foot below or beyond the boundary, and center-of-mass movement directed downward; reject both feet settled on one landing.

test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.finding: The render preserved continuous-thread evidence by sacrificing the cut endpoint, revealing tension between the continuity and cut gates.
test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.recommended_contract_refinement: Define continuity as one traceable same thread from spool through measurement to a single localized cut point, while requiring closed blades, a small severed gap, and a detached endpoint beyond that point.

test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.finding: A reference-bound face can drift or become non-comparable when complex action and wide composition dominate.
test_derived_candidate_pack_findings.recommended_contract_refinement: When appearance continuity is a control, reserve enough face size and a gaze angle that keeps eye aperture, face length, and lower-face width directly inspectable.
